video_title: Luka, Austin and the Squad Discuss the Season | Lakers Media Day 2026

quotes.speaker: Austin Reaves
quotes.summary_phrase: Austin Reaves describes his personal leadership style as one-on-one communication rather than public criticism.
quotes.excerpt: I like to talk to people one on one, have real conversation that way.
quotes.quote: I think that people lead in different ways. I am not someone that is going to sit out here and scream at people. I like to talk to people one on one, have real conversation that way. People will never feel like I am trying to embarrass them in front of people. Whenever we have a down period of time, pulling people to the side, talking to them about what I see, what I think they can do better, and just trying to give everybody my input and how I see things to help them moving forward.
quotes.social_post: Austin Reaves explains his leadership style. He prefers having real, one-on-one conversations with teammates rather than calling them out in front of the group.

quotes.speaker: Jarred Vanderbilt
quotes.summary_phrase: Jarred Vanderbilt outlines his role as a defensive leader and glue guy for the Lakers.
quotes.excerpt: I would say just you know doing what I'm capable of doing.
quotes.quote: I would say just you know doing what I'm capable of doing. You know setting that tone defensively, being a playmaker on that end, being a leader on that end, and just showing my versatility. Offensively, just being in the right spots, being able to finish plays, whether that's finishing at the rim or making shots, and just being a connected guy. Especially me being one of the guys that's been here a while, just kind of being that glue guy and that leading by example type of guy.
quotes.social_post: Jarred Vanderbilt is ready to step up as a leader for the Lakers this season. He says his focus is on setting the tone defensively and being a glue guy for the team.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Carr
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Carr shares his feelings about his first Lakers media day.
quotes.excerpt: It is like a first day of school again.
quotes.quote: It is like a first day of school again. I was nervous. I was on the phone with my mom before I walked in here. I was like, I just hope I represent myself well. And so, man, it is exciting now. It is exciting to be able to do this.
quotes.social_post: Cameron Carr says his first Lakers media day feels like the first day of school. He admits he was nervous before walking in, but is excited to be here.

quotes.speaker: Luka Doncic
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic says he feels excited and ready to play basketball after a long break.
quotes.excerpt: It feels great. Obviously it is a new challenge.
quotes.quote: It feels great. Obviously it is a new challenge. I was in this position in my career a lot of times, so it is not new to me, but I feel great. I feel excited and I am ready to go. It has been a long time since I played basketball, so I am ready.
quotes.social_post: Luka Doncic is feeling great and ready to get back on the court after a long break. He says he is excited for the new challenge this season.

quotes.speaker: Kevon Looney
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevon Looney highlights the importance of team chemistry built during a summer trip to Slovenia.
quotes.excerpt: Being connected, having a great chemistry is a big step to being a special team.
quotes.quote: Being connected, having a great chemistry is a big step to being a special team. There's going to be a lot of ups and downs and you have to be able to lean on that chemistry of being friends, being a family, being a brotherhood to do something special. I feel like that trip that we took this summer with Luka to Slovenia was a big step for us, building that chemistry, kind of learning each other, spending a lot of quality time with each other, getting to play with each other a little bit. It's really important.
quotes.social_post: Kevon Looney believes the team's summer trip to Slovenia was a crucial step in building the chemistry needed to be a special team this season.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Carr
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Carr discusses his intense weight room routine this summer.
quotes.excerpt: I have lifted every single day. I lift hard.
quotes.quote: I am in there every day. I show up and work hard. I have lifted every single day. I lift hard. I have been getting stronger. I have been working. Just working. Putting my head down and working.
quotes.social_post: Cameron Carr has been living in the weight room this summer. He says he has been lifting every single day to get stronger.

quotes.speaker: Walker Kessler
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler says the pressure of playing for the historic Lakers organization is an opportunity to compete for a championship.
quotes.excerpt: It makes me feel like that I can run through a brick wall for this organization.
quotes.quote: The Lakers organization is obviously an historic organization, and there is maybe added pressure to that, but I think for me, with that pressure comes a lot of opportunity to play on a stage like this and to compete for a championship. It makes me excited for this year, it makes me feel like that I can run through a brick wall for this organization, this team, my teammates.
quotes.social_post: Walker Kessler says playing for the historic Lakers organization is an opportunity to compete for a championship. He says the pressure makes him feel like he can run through a brick wall for his team.

quotes.speaker: Matisse Thybulle
quotes.summary_phrase: Matisse Thybulle emphasizes his defensive impact and readiness to contribute in any role.
quotes.excerpt: I know that how I play impacts winning and I know how much JJ values that.
quotes.quote: I think the work will speak for itself. I've been in the league for a while now and I know what I'm capable of. I know that how I play impacts winning and I know how much JJ values that. And for me, it's just being able to be in a position where I can do that. That's all I want to do and whether that means I'm in the starting lineup or I'm in the rotation or what, I don't that's not up for me to decide but I can show up and do my job and just see where the cards land.
quotes.social_post: Matisse Thybulle is confident that his defensive play impacts winning. He says he is ready to do his job regardless of his role in the rotation.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Carr
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Carr jokes about his secret to having a high vertical.
quotes.excerpt: I think that is where I get my bounce from, is Pop-Tarts.
quotes.quote: How I got my bounce, big candy person. I have a sweet tooth. I think that is where I get my bounce from, is Pop-Tarts.
quotes.social_post: Cameron Carr jokingly credits his high vertical to his love for Pop-Tarts.

quotes.speaker: Sandro Mamukelashvili
quotes.summary_phrase: Sandro Mamukelashvili reflects on his journey from being a 54th pick to signing with the Lakers.
quotes.excerpt: Today, putting this jersey on felt like something I only imagined and manifested in life.
quotes.quote: I don't think the words can describe how I feel, really. As you said, coming in as the 54th pick on a two-year two-way, you are on a short leash and I feel like a lot of times one wrong turn and you might be out of the league. So I got cut my second year and then San Antonio gave me a chance and I fought my way to this point. And today, putting this jersey on felt like something I only imagined and manifested in life.
quotes.social_post: Sandro Mamukelashvili reflects on his journey from being a 54th pick to signing with the Lakers. He says putting on the jersey is something he imagined and manifested in his life.

quotes.speaker: Jake Laravia
quotes.summary_phrase: Jake Laravia identifies defense and shooting as the keys to earning a rotation spot.
quotes.excerpt: It's going to come down to defense, who's going to be able to guard the opposing team's best player.
quotes.quote: It's going to come down to defense, who's going to be able to guard the opposing team's best player and guard them throughout the whole game, provide the most physicality towards them, and then who's also going to be able to knock down shots. That's going to be the other thing. So it's really just going to be who who's going to be the best 3 and D player for us, and it's also going to go along with you know who's going to pair best with Luka and AR as the head of the snake.
quotes.social_post: Jake Laravia says the competition for rotation spots will come down to who can play the best defense and knock down shots.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Carr
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Carr details the hard work he put in to learn how to dunk.
quotes.excerpt: I worked for one whole summer, then I finally started dunking the ball.
quotes.quote: I could not dunk. I wanted to dunk. I worked hard summer. I told my dad I wanted to dunk. I could not touch the rim and he was like, if you really want to, we can do it. So I worked for one whole summer, then I finally started dunking the ball.
quotes.social_post: Cameron Carr reveals he could not even touch the rim before he spent an entire summer working on his game to finally learn how to dunk.

quotes.speaker: Quentin Grimes
quotes.summary_phrase: Quentin Grimes says he takes pride in his defensive role and wants to do whatever is needed to help the Lakers win.
quotes.quote: I was installed that in college because Sam and Tibs and Greg were one of the guys that showed me how to be a pro, how to approach the game the right way. And everybody wants to have responsibility, whatever it is on the court. And mine happens to be defensively and I know what I am capable of offensively and they know that as well. So just to be able to have knowing that guard the best player every night, take on that challenge, want to be competitive, want to do whatever I can to help this team win, and that is all I want.
quotes.social_post: Quentin Grimes says he takes pride in his defensive role and wants to do whatever is needed to help the Lakers win. He says he is ready to take on the challenge of guarding the best player every night.

quotes.speaker: Bronny James Jr.
quotes.summary_phrase: Bronny James Jr. focuses on growth and applying coaching staff feedback to improve his game.
quotes.excerpt: I think the biggest thing for me is just continuing to grow.
quotes.quote: I think the biggest thing for me is just continuing to grow. You know every day coming in the gym with the right mindset, trying to get better, and then just taking all the tips that coaching staff gives me and applying it to my everyday routine, stuff like that. So I'm just continuing to get in better shape, you know get stronger in the gym and then ultimately make myself a better player.
quotes.social_post: Bronny James Jr. says his focus this season is on continuous growth, getting stronger, and applying the coaching staff's feedback to his daily routine.

quotes.speaker: Cameron Carr
quotes.summary_phrase: Cameron Carr credits his 40-inch vertical to his recovery from a knee injury.
quotes.excerpt: I came back from my knee injury and I had a 40-inch vertical.
quotes.quote: I got hurt and then I came back from my knee injury and I had a 40-inch vertical. And so, it is God's, God's blessing.
quotes.social_post: Cameron Carr says he developed a 40-inch vertical after returning from a knee injury.
